de: Erstes Release: komplette Anzeige (Tempo, Gefahren-Overlay, Gesehen?-Abfrage, Melden-Krone, Einstellungen, Kopplung)
BLE-Schnittstelle in Protokollversion 1 (acht Characteristics inkl. OTA-Update und SD-Dateiupload)
Straßenbild statt grüner Pfeile, Unfall-Symbol, Töne und Sprachansagen mit einstellbarer Lautstärke
en: First release: complete display (speed, hazard overlay, confirm prompt, report crown, settings, pairing)
BLE interface at protocol version 1 (eight characteristics incl. OTA update and SD file upload)
Road picture instead of green chevrons, accident glyph, chimes and voice announcements with adjustable volume

verified: Display, touch, all screens and overlays; BLE state/settings/time/reconnect with the PC test console
microSD mount and BLE file upload; audio playback in real time; volume 20/90/55 over BLE
Host tests (73 cases), contract vectors, Dart package (85 tests), firmware build in CI
notVerifiedOnTheBoard: The OTA transfer end to end, its failure cases and the boot rollback (test plan: docs/testing.md, Board verification)
UiConfig write + persistence after a reboot, the factory-reset flow, an audible check for crackle

knownLimitations: BLE link is open: no pairing or encryption is required, so any central in range can use every characteristic, including OTA and file upload (accepted for protocol v1).
No voice clips are included; without them voice announcements play the event chime.
Speed-camera categories can be removed at build time (CONFIG_BDSP_FEATURE_SPEEDCAM=n); see the legal notice in the README.
